crossRefs.note: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”
translations.bsb: And it was reported to the king of Jericho: “Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”
translations.kjv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
translations.asv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to-night of the children of Israel to search out the land.
